text:
sophia: Quick sync: we need a single hero chart + a tactical slide and intake flow for benchmark launch. Focus: latency vs $/1k tokens story, actionable levers, and inbound routing. Keep it simple for PMs and SDRs.

Tom: Proposal: a clean sweep chart (latency on X, $/k on Y) with three labeled bands (Real-time <100ms, Near-real-time 100-500ms, Background >500ms). Overlay arrows for optimize actions (batching, caching, quant) showing movement down/right.

Ana: Agree. Add three icons placed to indicate Hosted / Dedicated / Private typical positions. Also include a tiny inset microcase table (Startup Chatbot, Enterprise Assistant, Regulated Search) with sample tokens/mo and estimated $/mo.

Devon: For SDRs the microcase helps. Suggest sample: Startup Chatbot 99250k tokens/mo 99 target 200ms -> Recommended: Hosted + prefix cache = est $85/mo. We'll refine numbers later.

Sophia: Design constraints: colorblind palette, linear axes (no log), SVG hero 1200x600 and a slide export 16:9. Also need a simplified 1-column "how to move left/down" slide. Deadline: first assets by Wed COB.

Tom: Messaging: short tagline: "Choose your SLA. Control your cost." Blog headline: "From tokens to dollars: levers to hit your latency and TCO goals." Use both.

Ana: Intake form fields (devon please confirm): monthly_tokens, latency_target_ms, p95_or_avg, industry/compliance, sample_payload, contact. Also checkbox: share usage data for free config.

Devon: Yep. Ops-bot, can you wire tags for routing? (trial / sizing / compliance)

Ops-bot: @devon created form tco-intake-v1: https://forms.redwood/internal/tco-intake. Auto-tag rules: if monthly_tokens < 1e6 AND latency_target_ms >= 300 -> tag: trial. If monthly_tokens >= 1e6 OR latency_target_ms < 200 -> tag: sizing. If industry contains regulated OR compliance checked -> tag: compliance.

Sophia: Perfect. Include a one-line sales play per bucket on the slide: Trial: "Start on Hosted; enable cache; upgrade as you scale." Sizing: "Dedicated sizing + batching; reserve capacity." Compliance: "Private deployment + KMS support."

Tom: Add one sentence about fallbacks: "We auto-route to compatible model variants under heavy load to preserve availability" 99important for enterprise trust.

Ana: I'll draft 3 microcase blurbs and the 2-line caption for the hero chart.

Devon: Sales will need a simple ROI calc for the inset. Ops-bot, can you provide anonymized typical session sizes for chatbot buckets?

Ops-bot: @devon run `usage_fetch --bucket chatbot_smb --last 30d` to get anonymized medians; sample payload field will help match exactly.

Devon: Great. Also prefer to avoid precise numeric claims in the public blog; use "typical" or ranges unless we have permission.

Sophia: Good legal note. We'll use sample estimations and mark them as examples.

Tom: Webinar plan: 20m narrative (hero chart + microcases), 10m demo (showing batch/cache toggle & routing), 10m Q&A. Need speaker notes and 30s demo script.

Ana: I'll write speaker notes for hero slide and microcases. Add appendix slide with intake form flow and auto-tag rules for internal audience.

Sophia: Final checklist: 1) Design: hero svg, microcase png, slide export (Wed COB) 2) Copy: hero caption, microcases, sales blurbs (Thu AM) 3) Ops: intake + tags + sample fetch (Thu EOD) 4) Deck + speaker notes + rehearsal (Fri). Any blockers?

Devon: No blockers.

Tom: None. I'll prep demo recordings.

Ana: One UX ask: allow sample_payload paste up to 10k chars on the intake form so we can simulate exact token counts.

Ops-bot: @ana added field 'sample_payload' to tco-intake-v1 with 10k char limit.

Sophia: Great. I'll close this thread and post design links and first draft deck in #marketing when ready :party_popper:
